lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines observed on the dark grey torso; spacing is approximately equidistant with a slight increase in gap width between the 4th and 5th lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 4th line from the anterior, where the line splits before meeting the dorsal mane.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st anterior line terminates mid-flank; the 7th posterior line is abbreviated, failing to reach the ventral abdominal boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping consisting of 2 distinct white circular spots located on the mid-posterior haunch, approximately level with the hip joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiral geometry; horns emerge at approximately 45 degrees from the frontal plane, twisting laterally before curving inward and upward toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 2.8 times the combined width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately the terminal 12-15% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron mark between the eyes; high-contrast orange-tan pigmentation on the lower limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints; distinct white patches on the lower throat and upper chest.
